name: SMT101 Sensors
description: Hardware integration for the confirmed ZX-SMT1019-R157-V1.0A-10.1-GG-K1.29U-20260707 tablet, exposing its OEM MQTT sensors, switches, doors, and RGB backlight.
author: Stuart Pearson

settings.title: Host MQTT capture broker on this tablet
settings.description: Listens only on 127.0.0.1 for the OEM MQTT client running on this tablet, maps sensor publications to entities, and sends RGB backlight commands through the OEM MQTT topics. Connections from other devices are not accepted.

settings.title: MQTT client ID (optional)
settings.description: Must match client_id in the tablet's MQTT settings, for example office. The OEM client uses this value as its MQTT topic prefix. Leave blank to learn it automatically from status publications.
